admin.title: Authoring
admin.intro: Every article, chapter and news item on the site, with the state of each language.

access.needsPasskeyTitle: Sign in with your passkey to open authoring
access.needsPasskeyBody: Authoring only opens on a session started with a passkey, so a password alone can never publish to the site. Sign out, then sign in again with “Use a passkey”.
access.noPasskey: No passkey yet? Add one under Settings, Security first.

source.database: Content is served from the database. Changes to the JSON files in the repository are copied in on the next start, except for items edited here.
source.notConfigured: The database is not set up (DATABASE_URL is missing), so the site is serving the JSON files and nothing can be edited here yet.
source.unavailable: The database could not be reached, so the site is serving the JSON files. Check the server log; nothing can be edited until it is back.

admin.comingNext: Articles can be written, translated and published here. Chapters and news are edited in the next update; until then they come from the JSON files.
admin.summary: {articles, plural, one {# article} other {# articles}} · {chapters, plural, one {# chapter} other {# chapters}} ({written} written) · {news} news items

editor.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it on a published article changes its link.
editor.tagsHint: Separate with commas. Used by search.
editor.author: Author
editor.coverHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB, ideally 1600 × 900. Shown on cards and the home page.
editor.title: Title
editor.aiDraft: Machine-translated, not yet reviewed (readers see a label)
editor.bodyHint: Every language has the same blocks in the same order. Adding, moving or removing a block changes all languages; text is typed per language. Write '{section_80c_limit}' and similar to show current figures from the rule pack.
editor.saved: Saved. Published languages are live now.
editor.lastSaved: Last saved {when} by {who} · {count, plural, one {# saved version} other {# saved versions}}
editor.neverSaved: Not edited here yet: this article still matches its JSON file. Saving moves it to authoring for good.
editor.previewBanner: Preview of the last save in {language} ({state}). Readers only see published languages.

errors.slugTaken: Another article already uses this web address.
errors.notConfigured: The database is not available, so nothing can be saved right now.
errors.forbidden: Your session has ended or lacks a passkey. Sign in again with your passkey.
errors.failed: Saving failed. Your changes are still here; try again.

upload.notAnImage: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images can be uploaded.
upload.forbidden: Your session has ended or lacks a passkey. Sign in again with your passkey.
upload.notConfigured: The database is not available, so images can't be uploaded right now.

problems.quizAnswer: {language}: block {block} has a quiz answer that is not one of its options.
problems.unknownCalculator: {language}: block {block} points to a calculator that does not exist.
problems.structureDiffers: {language}: block {block} does not match the source.
